request.prompt: CRITICAL EXACT GEOMETRY: canvas 1536x1024. The 16 cells MUST be equal rectangles EXACTLY 768 wide by 128 high. No outer margin. Each room is a shallow panoramic strip of aspect ratio SIX TO ONE. Render a separate room in these precise bounding boxes: office [0,0,768,128], condo [768,0,1536,128], hotel [0,128,768,256], shop [768,128,1536,256], fast food [0,256,768,384], restaurant [768,256,1536,384], medical [0,384,768,512], security [768,384,1536,512], housekeeping [0,512,768,640], party hall [768,512,1536,640], cinema [0,640,768,768], metro [768,640,1536,768], lobby [0,768,768,896], parking [768,768,1536,896], recycling [0,896,768,1024], lift machinery [768,896,1536,1024]. ALL EIGHT ROWS SAME EXACT 128px HEIGHT. No growing top rows or shrinking bottom rows. Each room back wall top at cell y+4, furniture fully within cell, floor at cell y+116. All rooms must have full room art contained within these hard bounds. Do not draw separators or gutters. No text of any kind including parking letters. Use case: stylized-concept. Stylized 3D clay miniature, rounded matte molded forms, restrained pastel blue/sage/coral, soft ambient occlusion inside objects, clean large silhouettes. Straight-on orthographic SIDE CUTAWAY camera, absolutely no isometric or perspective rotation. Canvas exactly 1536x1024. Exact regular grid, no labels, text, logos, watermark, borders, gutters or cell outlines. Each subject completely contained in its exact cell. No objects cross cell boundaries. Each cell 768x128 pixels. Column boundary x=768. Row boundaries y=128,256,384,512,640,768,896. EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS of TWO very wide shallow rooms, never four rows or square rooms. Each is a fully contained straight-on cutaway room, floor baseline y=112 inside cell, back wall and furniture, no people. Fit all walls and furniture inside the shallow cell. Row 1: office desks/screens; condo sofa/kitchenette. Row 2: hotel bedroom; shop shelves/counter. Row 3: fast-food counter/stools; restaurant tables/kitchen. Row 4: medical clinic examination bed; security monitors. Row 5: housekeeping supply cart; party hall balloons/banquet. Row 6: cinema seats/screen; metro platform. Row 7: reception lobby; parking garage/car. Row 8: recycling bins; elevator machinery/pulleys. Exactly 16 rooms row-major.

visual_review.transport: 16 objects in correct 4x4 order; correction supplies 2 and 5 passengers in lift cells. Raw corrected PNG includes alpha; gray hidden RGB shown by viewer is not an opaque gray backdrop. Alpha inspected: 755711 fully transparent pixels, range 0..254. Preserve alpha. Some internal perspective remains in escalators and ramp.
visual_review.exterior_effects: 16 categories in correct 4x4 order. First three sky tiles have slight white edge margins. Distant skyline is stylized castle-like architecture. Flame silhouettes vary and are not registered seamlessly.
